defectFound.summary: A mouse press on any draggable block silently ends a live keyboard grab without restoring position and without an aria-live announcement, so the arrow-key move is committed by accident and a subsequent Escape is inert.
defectFound.origin: user report that 'Escape does not reset'
defectFound.finding: Escape itself is NOT broken — it restores correctly on all three regions, both immediately after a grab and after arrow moves, with announcement and focus intact. Six candidate mechanisms were tested differentially; only the pointer-interrupt path reproduced. Isolating contrast: clicking a neutral non-draggable area DOES restore.
defectFound.rcaAnchor: layout-region.vue Sortable onChoose: () => release() — release() clears the grab without the onReorder(id, originIndex) restore that cancel() performs, and onChoose fires on mousedown, before the handle's blur

openProductQuestions: Escape cannot undo a keyboard park (toggleHidden releases the grab on purpose); recovery is Space+ArrowUp from the parked zone but is not discoverable. Accepted gap or defect? Pinned as current behaviour by SR-HD-044.
Drag handle and hide control are 32x32 CSS px at 390px — passes WCAG 2.2 AA 2.5.8 (24x24) but breaches this repo's own <44x44 mobile heuristic; the design spec specifies VcButton xs.
The parked-zone empty hint (text-neutral-400 on the hatch) is readable but low-contrast in dark mode. Observation only — no contrast ratio measured.

deliveryFinding.summary: The theme half of VCST-5367 was live from 06:51 UTC; the backend half was not live until 09:32 UTC despite being pinned in the manifest.
deliveryFinding.rootCause: commit 87b7f118 left a trailing comma after the last element of Sources[0].Modules in vc-deploy-dev@vcptcore-qa backend/packages.json; jq failed to parse it, the platform base-image variable came out empty, and the docker build failed on 'failed to parse stage name ":"'
deliveryFinding.consequence: with the theme live and the module absent, the storefront's layout query returned HTTP 400 FIELDS_ON_CORRECT_TYPE, which is the design spec's loadFailed path — registry defaults + alert + Edit disabled, i.e. the feature was unreachable while the manifest said it was deployed
deliveryFinding.resolvedBy: upstream commit 28d72014 by the platform owner; no change required from this run
